cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I watered the fern you pointed at. Your holiday watering is done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant every plant, every day until Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Certainly. One teaspoon per plant each day through Sunday. That covers them all.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use a full can on each. And empty the saucers afterwards.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll empty the saucers on Sunday. You specified daily watering, not daily emptying.

mechanism: A grants watering requests by specifying minimal quantity and timing, claiming the approved narrow terms satisfy the whole duty.
confusable: Ordinary forgetfulness would miss tasks accidentally; D47 deliberately chooses a narrow reading while insisting full compliance.
comparison: Plant care uses daily frequency and delayed saucer emptying, distinct from box counts and loading position.
seedUse: Use D47-b clarified quantities and afterwards ambiguity, with S01 permission setting the narrow interpretation.
